note: Gate routing obligations bind Constellation nodes only. Quantum-L9/.github ProductKind `node` forbids direct_peer_routing_when_gate_is_required and requires gate_routed_inter_product_work; these four l9-ci-sdk rules (l9_ci/rulesets/semgrep/python/l9-routing.yml) enforce exactly that. A repository that declares product_kind `node` in .l9/ci.json receives the bundled Semgrep policy unchanged, so the rules block. Any other repository receives the same policy with only these rules set to `disabled`: they still run and are reported, but cannot fail the technical gate. Every other rule is unchanged. Change the rule list here after org review; a consumer cannot replace this file.
